question: Can the cue source drive a selective end-to-end circuit when every non-pool upstream component is base-clamped and only compiled response coordinates are installed?

frozen_program.source: replace wte output only at the single aligned changed cue token
frozen_program.upstream_graph: allow only the identical frozen 20-site atlas pool to respond through layers 0-10; base-clamp every other full head and MLP component
frozen_program.readers: four local-current c_v/Q maps plus four prospectively validated rank-64 MLP input covector maps
frozen_program.actuation: install only the eight generated projected responses into an independent base run
frozen_program.rows: temporal-v13 and is/was-v12 targets; temporal-v13 P controls
frozen_program.reference: the complete eight-site donor response patch, not the full donor model

predictions.pred_a_authority_top20_self_clamp_embedd: authorities replay, top20 agrees across fits, the no-source clamped graph is exactly base, target source touches one token, and <=24 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_source_clamped_graph_generates_co: for both fits every generated coordinate has signed projection >=0.75 and aggregate mean residual <=0.20 versus the full donor-input compiled coordinates
predictions.pred_c_source_clamped_compiled_program_i: both fits attain worst target residual <=0.15 and signed behavior projection >=0.80 on both tasks
predictions.pred_d_source_clamped_compiled_program_i: controls have normalized margin RMS <=0.10, median full-vocabulary KL <=0.02, and flip fraction <=0.05
predictions.pred_e_source_clamped_graph_is_crossfit_: even/odd minimum coordinate projection differs by <=0.05 and final per-task signed projections differ by <=0.05

decision: Passing is an end-to-end source-to-reader tensor program. Failure localizes missing recurrence inside the 20-site graph and triggers layerwise add-back, not unconstrained DAS optimization.
